executive_summary: The KYC Compliance Policy demonstrates moderate alignment with RBI Master Direction on KYC requirements.

gaps.description: The KYC policy does not include provisions for Enhanced Due Diligence on PEPs. RBI Master Direction mandates EDD measures including senior management approval.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add a PEP identification and EDD section with approval workflows and source-of-funds verification.

policy_clause.text: Customer identification shal be carried out at the time of opening an account. The bank shal verify identity using reliable documents such as passport, voter ID, or Aadhaar.
policy_clause.original_text: Customer identification shal be carried out at the time of opening an account.
policy_clause.title: CUSTOMER IDENTIFICATION PROCEDURES
policy_clause.semantic_summary: Mandates identity verification at account opening.

regulation_clause.text: Regulated entities shal apply enhanced due diligence for Politicaly Exposed Persons. Senior management approval shal be obtained before establishing a business relationship with a PEP.
regulation_clause.original_text: Regulated entities shal apply enhanced due diligence for PEPs.
regulation_clause.section: Chapter II, Clause 16 - EDD for PEPs
regulation_clause.title: ENHANCED DUE DILIGENCE FOR PEPs
regulation_clause.content: EDD measures for PEPs including senior management approval.
regulation_clause.semantic_summary: Requires EDD for PEPs with senior management approval.

remediation.draft_clause: The Bank shal implement PEP screening. Head of Compliance approval is required for PEP relationships.

gaps.description: The policy mentions transaction monitoring but lacks specifics on threshold amounts for STRs and CTRs. RBI guidelines require reporting of cash transactions exceeding INR 10 lakh.
gaps.suggested_fix: Enhance monitoring section with CTR thresholds (INR 10 lakh), STR timelines (7 days), and Principal Officer designation.

policy_clause.text: The compliance department shal monitor transactions on an ongoing basis and report any suspicious activities to authorities. Monitoring systems shal detect unusual patterns.
policy_clause.original_text: The compliance department shal monitor transactions and report suspicious activities.
policy_clause.title: TRANSACTION MONITORING AND REPORTING
policy_clause.content: Compliance monitors transactions and reports suspicious activities.
policy_clause.semantic_summary: Requires ongoing transaction monitoring and reporting.

regulation_clause.text: Regulated entities shal report to FIU-IND: cash transactions of value more than rupees ten lakh; suspicious transactions within 7 working days of forming suspicion.
regulation_clause.original_text: Regulated entities shal report to FIU-IND cash transactions and suspicious transactions.
regulation_clause.title: REPORTING OBLIGATIONS TO FIU-IND
regulation_clause.content: Cash transactions above INR 10 lakh and suspicious transactions must be reported.
key_obligations: Report cash transactions above INR 10 lakh
regulation_clause.semantic_summary: Mandates reporting of large cash and suspicious transactions to FIU-IND.

remediation.draft_clause: The Bank shal report to FIU-IND cash transactions exceeding INR 10 lakh and suspicious transactions within 7 working days.

gaps.description: The policy references PMLA 2002 but does not incorporate 2023 amendments. Record retention period references may be outdated.
gaps.suggested_fix: Update statutory references to latest PMLA amendments (2023). Align record retention to current 5-year requirement.

policy_clause.text: Records related to customer identification and transactions shal be maintained for a minimum period of ten years from the date of the transaction to enable reconstruction of individual transactions.
policy_clause.original_text: Records shal be maintained for a minimum of ten years.
policy_clause.title: RECORD KEEPING AND RETETTION
policy_clause.content: Customer and transaction records maintained for ten years.
policy_clause.semantic_summary: Requires record maintenance for at least 10 years.

regulation_clause.text: Regulated entities shal maintain records of transactions including CDD information for five years after the business relationship is ended. Records pertaining to ongoing investigations shal be retained until case closure.
regulation_clause.original_text: Regulated entities shal maintain records for five years after relationship ends.
regulation_clause.section: Chapter V, Clause 34 - Maintenance of Records
regulation_clause.title: MAINTENANCE OF RECORDS
regulation_clause.content: Records maintained for 5 years after relationship ends.
key_obligations: Maintain records 5 years after relationship ends
Retain STR records until case closure

remediation.draft_clause: Records shal be maintained for five years from cessation of business relationship. Policy reviewed annually for PMLA alignment.
